name: security
description: Security for a repository and its agents: pinned actions and an action-owner allowlist, a lock-file vulnerability scan and an SBOM, a provenance check before installing an agent skill or MCP server, a pre-push hook and a blocking gate check for secrets with an allow file and key-rotation runbooks, a pre-push hook that keeps private terms out of public repositories, a read-only access review that finds admin-bypass merges and organisation members without two-factor authentication, an inventory of every admin entrance with its owner, multi-factor method, and dated exceptions, threat models per RFC, vulnerability intake with fix-by dates, and a quarantine that keeps third-party text away from agents that hold tools: a store outside every indexed folder, a reader model with no tools, and a hook that denies every other read.
